title: Robot Arm Part Identifier
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: A labeling MicroSim for a six-axis robot arm: explore the seven named parts (base, shoulder, upper arm, elbow, forearm, wrist and end effector), then click each part as it is named. Used in Chapter 2.

educational.topic: Naming the parts of a robot arm
learningObjectives: Identify the seven named parts of a robot arm on a schematic, given each part's name, with at least 6 of 7 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore then retrieve: learn each name and job, then locate each part from its name
keyQuestions: Which parts are joints and which are links?
Is the shoulder the long piece or the joint?
commonMisconceptions: The shoulder is the long piece between the base and the elbow
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: 7 clicks, 6 correct for mastery

controls.label: Next name / See score / Try again
